messages:
Tara B.: Heads up — just uploaded the final slides to the drive (v3). Sorry for the late push, will be 1 slide swap at start.
Jamal: got it, linking in the thread: https://drive.redwood/v3-deck :thumbsup:
Mike (ops): FYI local recorder still on previous config. I'll re-point to the new deck, but need a quick OBS restart. ETA 45s.
Sophia: can you also check captions manifest? last all-hands had missing timestamps on slide 4.
Mike (ops): good call — restarting OBS now.
deploy-bot: OBS restart requested by Mike (ops) — job 4823 queued
Mike (ops): restart done. Confirming deck path is /allhands/v3-deck.pdf and slides match speaker notes.
Tara B.: thanks. @Elaine can you hold the Q&A queue for 3 mins while we switch? want to avoid timing gaps.
Elaine: yes, I'll hold and note the attendees who asked questions. Please ping when ready.
Jamal: mic routing — one of the stage mics was flaky last time. Can ops switch to the reserved Shure on channel 4?
Mike (ops): switching to Shure on ch4 now. Quick check: audio meters look healthy, -6db peaks.
Sophia: adding quick caption sync step: after final slide 3, trigger caption resync. Command below: 
```
# run on stream host
sudo systemctl restart captions-service && /usr/local/bin/caption-sync --source slides --offset -120ms
```
Mike (ops): ran the restart and the caption-sync with the offset. Logs show "sync complete".
Tara B.: perfect. Recording: please ensure local recorder uses the "allhands-v3" filename pattern so we can clip highlights easily.
Mike (ops): set to allhands-v3-2026-03-23.mp4
Elaine: Q&A note — leadership asked for 2 roadmap clarifications: 1) dedicated infra rollout timeline, 2) early access program for partners. I'll capture answers live.
Tara B.: Yep that'll be covered in the first 10 mins. If AV hiccups, we'll fallback to pre-recorded clip for the infra slide.
Jamal: if fallback needed, ops please cue clip ID 14 from media vault.
Mike (ops): noted — clip 14 preloaded to OBS, ready on hotkey F13.
Sophia: small nit — captions font weight is thin on the broadcast monitor. Can we bump to 700?
Mike (ops): increasing font-weight to 700 in styles now. Preview looks good.
Elaine: all set to hold Q&A until Tara says go.
Tara B.: ok switching slides in 10s... 9..8..7.. go. :mic-drop: :sparkles:
Jamal: seeing the updated slide, audio still stable.
Mike (ops): recorder rolling, OBS scene switched, captions synced.
Elaine: opening Q&A — first question from @molly about Dedicated SLA tiers. Tara?
Tara B.: we'll take that in the roadmap section; quick answer: SLAs are targeted for H2 with phased beta. Full details in follow-up doc.
Elaine: noted, logging response.
Sophia: if anyone sees drift in captions or audio, ping #eng-sre and I'll jump in.
Mike (ops): one small warning — disk usage on the recorder host at 84%. We have enough for the session but we'll cleanup temp captures after.
Tara B.: thanks, Mike. post all-hands please run the cleanup script.
Mike (ops): will do.
Tara B.: closing the live Q&A in ~2 mins, will post slides + recording link after processing. Thanks everyone for the quick swap. :raised_hands:
